name: Simplifying
project_description:

 Simplifying module allows you to make managing your website on Drupal 8 easier and more convenient. With our module, you can remove all unnecessary tabs, menu items or fields of materials.

 We will show you on the example of our website:

Here is the full version of the administrative panel with all the tabs of “Structure” 

Whereas here you can see only a few, the most important tabs for you.

Switching between full and abbreviated admin panel version is doing by the button on screenshot 

 The module extends to the created content. For example, we will use the “article” page.

In the full version of , the creation of an article contains more fields. With the help of our module you can leave only the necessary fields 

 Simplifying will allow you not to be distracted by extraneous information or searching for it among many tabs that are not used. The module itself has a convenient and clear settings panel 

 Check out our video about Simplifying module
